One-command install: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden.","id":"gh:1341085549","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-model-garden","slug":"mrdevlorx/dsh-model-garden","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-desktop","deepseek-harness-plugin","deepseek-harness-plugins","dsh","dsh-plugin","javascript","large-language-models","models","token-cost"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A searchable, sortable model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI — provider groups, favorites, mo"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"dels.dev prices, context windows, live per-task token cost and a local-model filter. One-command ins"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"tall: dsh plugin add dsh-model-garden."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-model-garden"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **model picker for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI** (`dsh web`) that replaces the native composer mod"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"el seat with a table-style picker: searchable, sortable, filterable down to model capabilities, with"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" prices, live per-task cost, a rich detail card and a pinned default model for every sub-agent."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The stock selector lists models. Model Garden answers the questions you actually have while picking "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"one: *what does it cost right now, which routes are cheap enough, which models can see images, which"},{"id":"p5s3","text":" can call tools, which are deprecated, and which model should every sub-agent use* — and it keeps th"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"ose answers in sync with your providers."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"### Picker and list"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Table-style list** grouped by provider — click `Name`, `Ctx` or `Price` to sort (asc → desc → ba"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ck to grouped), collapsible groups, per-provider counts
- **Keyboard-first** — `↑ ↓` navigate, `Home"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"`/`End` jump, `Enter` select, `Esc` close
- **Instant search** across names, ids, descriptions and p"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"rovider names — **and the model's facts**: `vision`, `tool calling`, `reasoning`, `structured output"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"`, `attachments`, `open weights`, `temperature`, `interleaved`, family, knowledge cutoff, release da"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"te and `deprecated`
- **Favorites** (⭐, persisted) and a **hidden models/providers blacklist** (✕ on"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" hover, managed in the ⚙ panel, persisted) — the blacklist never touches your DSH configuration
- **"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"Local / Live awareness** — providers are flagged *local* by their real endpoint (loopback / RFC1918 "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"/ LAN hostnames, never by price), and local gateways are probed for the models they currently serve"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Advanced search (facet sheet)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The **Filters** button opens a two-column sheet above the picker. Every option carries the number of"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" models it would match, and the header counts the result (`Filters · 12 of 88`):"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Group | Options |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| **Scope** | Local only · Live only · Favorites only |
| **Capabilities** | Tool calling · Vision ·"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" Reasoning · Effort levels · Open weights · Structured output · Attachments · Temperature · Interlea"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"ved |
| **Limits** | Context ≥ 32K…1M · Input price ≤ $0.50/$1/$3/$10 · Knowledge cutoff year · Fami"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ly |
| **Lifecycle** | Deprecated only |
| **Providers** | one provider from a dropdown (Configured "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"/ Hidden, each with its model count) |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Everything is derived from **your** installation at runtime — no provider, model or family name is h"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" is derived from **your** installation at runtime — no provider, model or family name is hard-coded:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- providers, counts and the `hidden` flag come from the live directory and your blacklist
- capabili"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ty counts, families, knowledge years, context sizes and prices come from the models.dev catalog cach"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"e
- an option with **zero matches is disabled**, and a whole group is **not rendered** when your cat"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"alog cannot fill it (a local-only setup still gets Scope, Lifecycle and Providers)
- the Context lad"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"der only offers thresholds your models can reach; the knowledge years are the ones in your catalog"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Filters combine with the text search (AND). **Reset** is always visible (dimmed while nothing is set"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"), clears every filter and leaves the search text alone."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Detail card"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Hovering a row opens the detail card as a **fixed companion to the picker**: left gutter, 1 px seam,"},{"id":"p17s2","text":" shared bottom edge. On narrow windows it moves **above** the picker instead of hanging off screen, "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"and it is height-clamped to the viewport."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The card is a **table** (`Property | Value`) with sections:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- **Model** — context, max output, reasoning efforts, price per 1M (in / out / cache read / cache wr"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ite)
- **Capabilities** — modalities, tool calling, structured output, temperature, attachments, ope"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"n weights, interleaved reasoning
- **Lifecycle** — knowledge cutoff, release date, last update, depr"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ecation status, family, aliases, canonical id
- **Provider** — route, models.dev provider and env ke"},{"id":"p19s5","text":"y, local-gateway metadata, provenance of each source"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Facts merge three sources (DSH adapter via `llm.resolveModelInfo`, models.dev, and the raw `/models`"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" record of a local gateway) and are cached, so the first hover after a restart is never blank."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The package is a **static profile plugin** with two halves:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Half | File | Role |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| Client | `client.js` | Registers the `conversation.input.model` slot (shadowing the native seat) a"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nd renders the picker, filter sheet, detail card and effort dropdown |
| Host | `index.js` | Same-or"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"igin JSON routes on the harness `webServer`, catalog/detail caches, and the sub-agent enforcement on"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" `agents.create` / `agents.resume` |
| Shared logic | `lib/refresh-core.js`, `lib/pi-catalog.js`, `l"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ib/detail-core.js`, `lib/subagent-core.js` | Dependency-free, unit-tested pieces: provider discovery"},{"id":"p24s6","text":" + merge, pi-ai catalog loading, detail-card merge rules, sub-agent override semantics |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- Developed and tested against **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1** (rc.4 and rc.5) and carries the 0.1 code p"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"aths: provider routes are read through `ctx.configEditor` on 0.2 and through the legacy settings doc"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ument on 0.1; writes go through the profile's configuration editor (0.2) with the old deep-merge as "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"fallback
- The client half is plain React through `window.__ModuleLoader__`; no build step, no depen"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"dencies
- The sub-agent override rides on `meta.origin: "subagent"` / `parentAgent` — the same seam "},{"id":"p26s6","text":"`dsh-subagent` uses
- The cost endpoints read the durable session log through the session facade (`s"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"napshotEvents()`, falling back to `ownEvents()` / `events`)
- Capability, price, family and knowledg"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"e filters need the models.dev catalog; without it the sheet simply offers the subset your data can f"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ilters need the models.dev catalog; without it the sheet simply offers the subset your data can fill"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"> Slot note: the client declares `remote` + `remote.session` in its inject list. `modelDirectories.d"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"irectoryFor()` reaches into `ctx.remote.session`, and a cordis proxy binds `ctx` to the calling fibe"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"r — without those declarations the slot's inject factory throws and the native picker takes the seat"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"thout those declarations the slot's inject factory throws and the native picker takes the seat back."}],"truncated":true}
